steps.instructions: Decide what this artifact editor plugin is: its id (vendor-prefixed, kebab-case, never wicked or wicked-*, which are reserved for the editors that ship inside wicked-studio; read GET $WICKED_CREW_URL/api/v1/editors and pick an id no installed editor holds), its title in plain words, the artifact kinds it opens (page, document, deck, demo-video, walkthrough, rfp-response, or a kind of its own), what it shows and what it lets the user do, the permissions that needs with a plain-words why for each (artifact.read, selection.chip, checks.contribute and ui.fullscreen are allowed by default; artifact.write, composer.draft, checks.read, sources.read, media.read, artifact.export and artifact.theme ask the operator; network.media is not offered to a pack editor; mcp.session, for an editor of kind mcp-server that inspects an MCP server the operator connects in the host, is granted only by the operator's install approval), and the target: this run's repository, at its root when the repository is new and near-empty, or in a named subdirectory when it already holds code. Say whether the operator wants it installed when the run completes (the install phase asks again at its gate). If the intent names a repository that is not this run's, say that the operator must create it with an initial commit and register it before a run can deliver into it; do not try to create one. If the brief says `Kind: phase plugin.`: use protocol 3 and a spec-2 plugins[] entry (CONTRACT-CS7 C1), with no permissions; declare 1-16 unique observe[] topics with a plain-words why each. Topics have at most 120 characters, start wicked.run. and have dot-separated segments [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,40} or *, with ** allowed only as the last segment; the install consent grants exactly those topics. Declare panels[] with slot run.details. Follow garden's skills/editor-scaffold/refs/run-plugin.md and scripts/editor/scaffold.py --kind run-plugin; the engine checks r0-manifest, r1-handshake, r2-no-network, r3-topics, r4-replay and r5-hash-pinned (r0-r5 instead of editor cases 0-18). Scope the section in each job's Details, its id in the shared editor/plugin namespace, title, event topics and reasons, and what the section shows; keep the repository and install intent decisions above.

Produce the contract against DES-EDITOR-PLUGINS-001 and DES-EDITOR-PLUGIN-CONTRACT-001 (protocol 2; the editor-scaffold skill's section 2 and its Surfaces section are the checklist): the manifest entry (id, title, version, protocol [1, 2], kinds, sizes with inline required, each permission and its why) and its surfaces declaration, which the host renders and the plugin never draws itself (the card: interactive or not, its aspect, at most 4 actions drawn by the host, each verb plugin, host:export or host:ask; the options tabs, at most 5, each plugin-rendered or host-drawn controls from the closed vocabulary; full screen, with modes simple and advanced or none; every label 1-24 plain characters and never one of the host's decision words), the host-to-plugin messages it handles (host.hello with its surface, tab and mode; host.ping within 2 s; host.surface card to full without a reload or a second plugin.ready; host.mode answered within 2 s with the mode now shown; host.action answered within 2 s with handled true or false, and no user activation taken from it; host.tab; host.selection; options.changed answered with the tab's values and rev; host.theme; artifact.changed) and how it ignores an unknown or malformed one, every plugin-to-host request it makes with the permission each needs (least privilege: nothing asked for that no request uses), any edits as text and colour ops only with stale and head_moved shown to the user, the key rules (only Escape, Mod+K, Alt+letter and Tab at the edges forwarded; the first printable key goes to the composer as one ui.typed; Backspace and Delete never remove), content rendered as text never as live markup, no network, keyboard reach and a visible focus ring, and no animation under reduced motion. Name every deviation and why. If the brief says `Kind: phase plugin.`: use protocol 3 and a spec-2 plugins[] entry (CONTRACT-CS7 C1), with no permissions; declare 1-16 unique observe[] topics with a plain-words why each. Topics have at most 120 characters, start wicked.run. and have dot-separated segments [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,40} or *, with ** allowed only as the last segment; the install consent grants exactly those topics. Declare panels[] with slot run.details. Follow garden's skills/editor-scaffold/refs/run-plugin.md and scripts/editor/scaffold.py --kind run-plugin; the engine checks r0-manifest, r1-handshake, r2-no-network, r3-topics, r4-replay and r5-hash-pinned (r0-r5 instead of editor cases 0-18). Design the observe-only section: inline run-thread, entry and pinned sha256, 1-4 panels with unique ids and order, protocol-3 host.hello with observe, events.batch handling and optional panel.summary. Render event content as text, ignore unknown or malformed messages, and define replay and live updates without duplicates, keyboard reach, focus and reduced motion.

Scaffold the pack with the skill (scripts/editor/scaffold.py, with --surfaces <file.json> when the design's declaration is not the default) into the target directory: wicked-pack.json spec 2 with one editors[] entry (protocol [1, 2] and the design's surfaces) and its one self-contained entry file editors/<id>/index.html, built on the template's protocol-2 plumbing, whose plugin.ready carries the same surfaces byte for byte (the first-party wicked-page plugin is the reference for the contract). Write the editor the design named, keep every script and style inline and nothing loaded from outside the file, mark the control that saves with data-wicked-save (the conformance case 7-edit fills the visible fields and clicks it, and expects exactly one new version; an editor that never writes asks no artifact.write and passes it as a viewer), re-pin the entry hash with scripts/editor/pin.py after every edit, and pass pack check. Keep exactly one editor pack in the tree, as plain files (no links). The engine runs the editor conformance cases on this host right after this step (your seat has no headless browser, so do not run scripts/editor/conformance.py yourself); a failed case comes back to you as a send-back naming the case, as a finding to fix. If the brief says `Kind: phase plugin.`: use protocol 3 and a spec-2 plugins[] entry (CONTRACT-CS7 C1), with no permissions; declare 1-16 unique observe[] topics with a plain-words why each. Topics have at most 120 characters, start wicked.run. and have dot-separated segments [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,40} or *, with ** allowed only as the last segment; the install consent grants exactly those topics. Declare panels[] with slot run.details. Follow garden's skills/editor-scaffold/refs/run-plugin.md and scripts/editor/scaffold.py --kind run-plugin; the engine checks r0-manifest, r1-handshake, r2-no-network, r3-topics, r4-replay and r5-hash-pinned (r0-r5 instead of editor cases 0-18). Scaffold with --kind run-plugin into the target directory, implement the designed section and samples/events.ndjson on protocol-3 plumbing, keep the entry self-contained, re-pin after every edit and pass pack check. Use this plugin contract in place of the editor surfaces and save controls above. Keep one pack as plain files; let the engine run conformance after build.

Judge the delivered editor pack. The engine ran the editor conformance cases itself on this host, in its jail, after the build: its [editor conformance record] in your context is this run's conformance evidence. Cite it: every case 0-16 and 18 passed for every editor (7 saves through the editor's own UI, 18 shows the content it is handed, 13-16 are the protocol-2 cases: the surfaces the host renders are the manifest's, the card, each options tab, full screen with its modes), on the tree you review, and its entry sha256 equals the manifest's. Do not run scripts/editor/conformance.py in your seat: no seat has a headless browser, and its absence there is not a finding. Then judge what the cases cannot see (the editor's own behaviour against the design: whether what it shows and what it saves are right, what each control does, what it writes) by reading the code and exercising its logic, and record your QE evidence. If the brief says `Kind: phase plugin.`: use protocol 3 and a spec-2 plugins[] entry (CONTRACT-CS7 C1), with no permissions; declare 1-16 unique observe[] topics with a plain-words why each. Topics have at most 120 characters, start wicked.run. and have dot-separated segments [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,40} or *, with ** allowed only as the last segment; the install consent grants exactly those topics. Declare panels[] with slot run.details. Follow garden's skills/editor-scaffold/refs/run-plugin.md and scripts/editor/scaffold.py --kind run-plugin; the engine checks r0-manifest, r1-handshake, r2-no-network, r3-topics, r4-replay and r5-hash-pinned (r0-r5 instead of editor cases 0-18). Judge the delivered run plugin against its design and cite the engine's [editor conformance record] for every plugin on this tree, including its entry hash and r0-r5. Check topic filtering, replay without gaps or duplicates and live updates; use these run cases in place of the editor cases above. Record the separate QE evidence; do not run the harness in your seat.

Review the diff cold as a sandbox and least-privilege review of an editor plugin (DES-EDITOR-PLUGINS-001 sections 6 and 8): every permission the manifest asks for is used by a request in the code that needs it, and no request needs a permission it did not ask for; nothing reaches the network (no fetch, XHR, WebSocket, EventSource, beacon, form, navigation, WebRTC, or a script, stylesheet, image, font or frame from outside the file); artifact content is rendered as text or through DOMParser, never as live markup; messages go only to the host's port after the one plugin.ready, and an unknown or malformed message is ignored; no key or typed text approves, sends, deletes or writes, and only the forwardable keys are forwarded; the entry's sha256 in wicked-pack.json matches the file. Cite file and line for every finding. If the brief says `Kind: phase plugin.`: use protocol 3 and a spec-2 plugins[] entry (CONTRACT-CS7 C1), with no permissions; declare 1-16 unique observe[] topics with a plain-words why each. Topics have at most 120 characters, start wicked.run. and have dot-separated segments [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,40} or *, with ** allowed only as the last segment; the install consent grants exactly those topics. Declare panels[] with slot run.details. Follow garden's skills/editor-scaffold/refs/run-plugin.md and scripts/editor/scaffold.py --kind run-plugin; the engine checks r0-manifest, r1-handshake, r2-no-network, r3-topics, r4-replay and r5-hash-pinned (r0-r5 instead of editor cases 0-18). Review the plugin against its declared topics and reasons, with no doc.*, steer.* or other permissions, no network and no intercept hooks. Check only granted topics reach the section, replay and live rows cannot duplicate, content is text, messages use the host port, malformed messages are ignored and the entry hash matches. Cite file and line for every finding.

Plan the install without writing anything: resolve, on this host and as the daemon user, every file and directory each install choice would write — Install for this daemon (the default: the staged copy under ~/.wicked/editors/<name>/current, the copy it replaces kept in previous, the install record, and the wicked-crew editor registry entry in the daemon's state home) and Install, turned off (the same places, with the editor registered off) — and print them as one JSON plan line, so the install's consent gate can list them before you answer. If the brief says `Kind: phase plugin.`: use protocol 3 and a spec-2 plugins[] entry (CONTRACT-CS7 C1), with no permissions; declare 1-16 unique observe[] topics with a plain-words why each. Topics have at most 120 characters, start wicked.run. and have dot-separated segments [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,40} or *, with ** allowed only as the last segment; the install consent grants exactly those topics. Declare panels[] with slot run.details. Follow garden's skills/editor-scaffold/refs/run-plugin.md and scripts/editor/scaffold.py --kind run-plugin; the engine checks r0-manifest, r1-handshake, r2-no-network, r3-topics, r4-replay and r5-hash-pinned (r0-r5 instead of editor cases 0-18). Include each topic and its why in the JSON plan for consent, along with every path and registry write above; plan the plugin registered on or off as chosen, without installing anything.

cmd: exec "${WICKED_GARDEN_ROOT:?the engine handed this Tool phase no garden root; refusing to resolve wicked-garden from PATH}/scripts/wicked-garden" run scripts/editor/install.py --from-run --dry-run --json

steps.instructions: Install for running — or update the installed copy when this pack is already installed. Nothing has been installed yet: this asks before the install runs, and each answer lists exactly the files it would write (from the install-plan dry run). Install for this daemon (the default) stages the pack from this run's tree into ~/.wicked/editors/<name>/current and registers it with wicked-crew's editors, which re-runs pack check and the conformance cases itself and refuses on any failure; the editor is then listed in studio Settings → Developer → Editor plugins and opens in the editor dev host. Install, turned off does the same and leaves it off until you switch it on there. Both write program-owned places only, on the daemon host as the daemon user. Decline for not now — the pull request already delivered stays as it is. If the brief says `Kind: phase plugin.`: use protocol 3 and a spec-2 plugins[] entry (CONTRACT-CS7 C1), with no permissions; declare 1-16 unique observe[] topics with a plain-words why each. Topics have at most 120 characters, start wicked.run. and have dot-separated segments [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,40} or *, with ** allowed only as the last segment; the install consent grants exactly those topics. Declare panels[] with slot run.details. Follow garden's skills/editor-scaffold/refs/run-plugin.md and scripts/editor/scaffold.py --kind run-plugin; the engine checks r0-manifest, r1-handshake, r2-no-network, r3-topics, r4-replay and r5-hash-pinned (r0-r5 instead of editor cases 0-18). Apply the consented plan and its exact topics through crew; a new version or entry hash needs fresh consent. List the installed section under Job details in /plugins, on or turned off as chosen; on appears in every job's Details, and Remove withdraws its topic grants. Decline installs nothing.

cmd: exec "${WICKED_GARDEN_ROOT:?the engine handed this Tool phase no garden root; refusing to resolve wicked-garden from PATH}/scripts/wicked-garden" run scripts/editor/install.py --from-run --target "${WICKED_CONSENT_CHOICE:?the consent gate recorded no install choice}" --json
